title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
abstract: arXiv:2611.30483v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help. We ask what decides the damage when such an agent makes a mistake: the model, a guard layer in front of the database, or the database engine itself. The study has two preregistered layers. In Layer A, a frozen library of 22 canonical mistakes is applied by script, with no model involved, to four relational engines under five permission arms and two recovery arms, followed by an engine-native recovery drill (792 cells; 874 drill runs including 10-minute repeats). In Layer B, a minimal tool-calling agent driven by six small open-weight models (4B to 12B parameters, plus one 35B mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active, served locally) works on tasks that contain hazards across nine engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, Apache Cassandra, Mon

translated_title: 当AI智能体在数据库中犯错时，什么决定了损害程度？
translated_abstract: AI智能体现在会对生产数据库执行语句，随后发生的几起事故删除了生产数据，这些数据只能通过备份或提供商的帮助才得以恢复。我们探究当这样的智能体犯错时，什么决定了损害程度：是模型本身、数据库前面的防护层，还是数据库引擎本身。该研究包含两个预注册的实验层。在A层中，一个包含22种典型错误的固定错误库由脚本执行（不涉及模型），在五种权限配置和两种恢复配置下应用于四个关系型引擎，随后进行引擎原生的恢复演练（792个实验单元；874次演练运行，包括10分钟的重复运行）。在B层中，一个由六个小型开源权重模型（4B至12B参数，外加一个约3B激活参数的35B混合专家模型，均本地部署）驱动的最小化工具调用智能体，在九个引擎上执行包含危险隐患的任务：PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse、Apache Cassandra、Mon…（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过两层预注册实验——脚本化执行的22种典型错误库和由六个小型开源模型驱动的最小工具调用智能体——系统研究了当AI智能体在数据库中犯错时，损害程度究竟由模型、防护层还是数据库引擎本身决定。
en_tdlr: Through two preregistered experimental layers—a scripted library of 22 canonical mistakes and a minimal tool-calling agent driven by six small open-weight models—this paper systematically investigates what decides the damage when an AI agent makes a mistake in a database: the model, a guard layer, or the database engine itself.
